instrumentation: Appends a read-only reference to existing sessions module objects; no API/function behavior replacement. Inputs use fill/Tab, checkbox, mouse, or trusted browser touch contacts.

definitions.name: Angle

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: White wire analog output is specified as 0..2500mV. Official AngleUnit uses the host ADC with 11dB attenuation; read_u16 is host ADC scaling rather than an I2C value.
gaps: Mechanical angle-to-voltage transfer and SoC-specific ADC conversion/attenuation need a controller model.

claims: guest driver transaction path and encoding

runtime.blocker: Controller model is compiled; same-guest and Web validation are pending

definitions.blocker: The official contract is documented, but no external Unit controller model, board routing and device-local runtime evidence is validated by this research artifact. Open protocol/electrical questions: Mechanical angle-to-voltage transfer and SoC-specific ADC conversion/attenuation need a controller model.
definitions.input_semantics: External world/fixture state, to be delivered through a controller-level device model; not direct guest API return values.
definitions.output_semantics: Observed guest-to-Unit output; read-only to clients.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
